value.name: self-defense student defeats attacker
value.description: A woman in the self-defense class is attacked by a mugger, but she fights back by stomping his foot and smashing his face until he submits.
evidence: A woman walking across a gymnasium floor. Suddenly, she's assaulted by a huge, grotesquely garbed assailant.
She reacts swiftly. With a ferocious "NO," she stomps on his foot, and smashes him in the face.
The mugger raises his hands in a gesture of submission.
we are in a Self Defense Class.

value.name: Marylin and Sarah discuss Ruth's proposals
value.description: Sitting against the wall, Marylin tells Sarah that she does not understand why a man has rejected all of Ruth's proposals.
evidence: Marylin and Sarah sit against the wall.
MARYLIN I don't know what his game is. He dismissed every one of Ruth's proposals.

value.name: Marylin notes Ruth's surprise
value.description: Marylin says Ruth stayed composed but was visibly surprised by the man's behavior.
evidence: Ruth kept her cool, but I could tell she was surprised.

value.name: Sarah comments on his reputation
value.description: Sarah responds that the man has a reputation for being tough.
evidence: SARAH He has a reputation for being tough.

value.name: Marylin watches next victim begin
value.description: Marylin notices that another woman, Lilly, is about to take her turn in the self-defense exercise.
evidence: Marylin watches as a new "victim" begin her walk across the gym.

value.name: mugger scares Lilly into fleeing
value.description: The mugger approaches Lilly, and she panics, screams, and runs for the exit.
evidence: The mugger emerges from his station and makes his way toward the "victim."
She glances over her shoulder, and at the sight of the monster bearing down on her, screams and runs to the exit.

value.name: Marylin and Sarah laugh at Lilly
value.description: Marylin and Sarah giggle at Lilly's panic, then quickly force themselves to look concerned when the other students disapprove.
evidence: Marylin and Sarah giggle, but reproachful looks from the other students force them to affect concerned looks.

value.name: Marylin remarks on weekly pattern
value.description: Marylin whispers that this kind of reaction happens every week, and Sarah says she is overwhelmed by it.

value.name: instructors coax sobbing woman back
value.description: The instructors and mugger try to persuade the crying woman to return to the room and physically comfort her.
evidence: The two Instructors and the Mugger try to coax the sobbing woman back into the room.
